summary: Today brings a mixed legal and commercial landscape driven by Supreme Court ruling on precedent adherence and new GST tax exemptions. On the market front, record UPI festive transaction volumes contrast sharply with electronics manufacturers cutting production by up to 20%.

bullets.text: Supreme Court ruled DVC's Sinking Fund contribution and depreciation are valid tariff components, holding review contrary to binding precedent violates Article 141.
The Centre exempted Psyllium Seeds (Isabgol) under tariff item 1211 90 13 from CGST, IGST, and UTGST effective November 1, 2026.
UPI processed a record Rs 31.53 lakh crore in October transactions, achieving a 16% year-on-year growth driven by festive shopping.
Electronics manufacturers plan to cut TV and smartphone production by up to 20% following weaker festive demand and mounting inventory.
E-commerce platform Meesho appointed former GCPL Chief Executive Officer Sudhir Sitapati as an independent director on its board.
